coaching.headline: No tank to start fights: Drongo fed on 14 kills while the enemy took every Fangtooth, both Primes, the Shaper and nine structures.

flags.text: Drongo went a damn 14/2/1, killing Khaimera five times and Kira and Phase three times each.
Five deaths outside any detected fight, three Wraith and two Khaimera, all shortly before enemy major objectives.
No tank against Steel, two divers in Greystone and Khaimera, and all five heroes dealing physical damage.
All five lost fights came with an enemy tower or major; the single won fight returned no prize.

focus.title: Counter-engage around Drongo
focus.action: With no tank, let the enemy engage first: hit Drongo after Shrapnel Cannon is spent, hold Energy Lance for divers on Kira, and Wraith and Khaimera travel with a teammate before every major.

14.6.call: Lost 0-3 in two separate plays: Zarus killed Greystone and Renna killed Khaimera on the offlane, Drongo killed Kira on the duo lane, then the duo outer and Mini Prime fell. After an early death, the other lane plays safe.

18.5.call: Lost 1-3 on the mid lane right after the mid outer fell: Renna killed Wraith first, then Drongo killed Khaimera and Greystone. With Wraith down first, the call was holding the mid inner, not a fight.

24.5.call: Lost 1-4 in the allied base after Bayle's Primal Fangtooth and Zarus's mid inhibitor; Khaimera killed Drongo in the same second the Core fell. Once Primal Fangtooth is lost, all five hold at the inhibitors.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Three of four deaths went to Drongo. Trade only after Shrapnel Cannon is spent, and buy Equinox for tenacity whenever the enemy drafts more hard CC.
Took the lone enemy structure of the game, the duo outer tower. After any Drongo death, push the duo lane to the next tower with Phase.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: All three deaths went to Drongo, two before minute ten. Against a Drongo lane, buy Tainted Charm early for tenacity and cast after Gag Grenade's silence lands elsewhere.
Kill participation 30%, 7459 healing and 9 wards against an own average of 10.7, but no enemy ward cleared. If carrying a sentry, sweep the Fangtooth pit before each spawn.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Six deaths and 340 hero damage per minute against an own average of 679. When Renna or Drongo goes unseen, play behind the nearest standing mid tower until Khaimera shows.
Ran the vision: 20 wards, the most in the game, plus two Seedlings taken. Before the next Fangtooth or Prime, ward the pit with Khaimera or Greystone alongside.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Mitigated 28413 damage and farmed 9.6 CS a minute against an own average of 7.7. With no tank drafted, step in only after Steel's Shield Slam is spent.
A kill on Renna in the mid fight ended in a death to Drongo, and the offlane inner fell next. Leave the offlane only once Zarus is dead.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Seven deaths, the most in the game, five to Drongo. Save Cull's suppress for Drongo, and add Salvation for tenacity when the enemy carry keeps winning fights.
Bayle took every Fangtooth, Mini Prime, Shaper and Primal Fangtooth. When Bayle shows on a lane, start the next pit with Greystone and Wraith.

matchup: Duo lane against Drongo and Steel; Drongo killed this carry three times and dealt 32871 hero damage, the most in the game.
Both duos lost three lives before minute ten; this carry's lone kill landed on Drongo at the Fangtooth pit.
Drongo's in-air Shrapnel Cannon launches Drongo backward, briefly unstoppable.
build: Vanquisher is one of the 59.5% core; Solaris and Imperator never made the build.
Tainted Rounds came in the final fight, so earlier fights ran without the 45% healing cut on basic attacks.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles on damaging a hero below 30% health, with a 10s cooldown per hero.
Lotus leans ahead in this carry field; Weald, the most played, ranks fifth.
Forage with Wind-Rider is the best Weald pair. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Bringer Of Mercy: Mercy costs 10 less mana, and dealing damage cuts current ability cooldowns by 0.75s.
Bringer Of Mercy leans ahead in this carry field. Sound keep.
crest: Pacifier's Adrenalize dashes and empowers the next physical hit, dealing 2.5x against targets below 20% max health.
Ortus leans ahead in this carry field; Pacifier, the most played, ranks second among crests with enough games.
improvement: Lane record into Drongo: 48.8%. Tenacity via Equinox and physical armor were NOT built; Tainted Rounds met the anti-heal need.
Equinox over Scattershot adds 20 tenacity and a shield on dropping below 40% health, giving up Scattershot's extra projectiles.
Into Drongo the field's most played core is Solaris, Ashbringer and Imperator, at 62.3%.

matchup: Duo lane against Steel and Drongo; Steel placed 12 wards to 9 and logged 13 assists.
Steel's hard CC: Shield Bash stuns, Bull Rush knocks back, Shield Slam knocks up and stuns.
build: Marshal and Windcaller are two of the 55.4% core; Galaxy Greaves never made the build.
Windcaller came in the final fight; Zephyr gives the support and a healed ally 8% movement speed.
Marshal buffs the support and nearby heroes with 15% attack speed and on-hit damage.
eternal: Knell's Rust stacks shred enemy physical and magical armor, and the attacker gains 75% of the armor shredded.
Knell has too few games to lead this support field; Vesh and Exarch are a toss-up at the top.
Patina with Peal is the best Knell pair; Frequency with Peal was run.
augment: Psychic Support makes Essence Catalyst also restore the linked ally's mana, based on missing mana.
Psychic Support and Kindred Surge are a toss-up in this support field. Sound keep.
crest: Tranquility's Grace heals the support and nearby heroes and grants 10% damage mitigation for 2s.
Silentium leans ahead in this support field; Tranquility, the most played, ranks third among crests with enough games.
improvement: Lane record into Steel: 47.7%. Tenacity, anti-heal, physical armor and magical armor were all NOT built.
Tainted Charm over Prophecy adds 25 tenacity and cuts nearby enemy healing 45%, giving up magical on-hit damage.
Galaxy Greaves, in the field core, adds 30 physical and 30 magical armor.

matchup: Mid against Renna, a 45.2% lane record; Renna, Drongo and Steel killed this mid twice apiece.
Renna's Stupor sleeps and Mortal Coil pulls, two of ten enemy hard-CC abilities.
build: Alternator and Vanquisher are two of the 61% core; Solaris never made the build.
Only two items finished: Alternator raises Alternate Ability damage 15%, and Vanquisher executes heroes taken below 5% health.
eternal: Xyris adds bonus damage that grows with units killed, capped at 400 units.
Lotus, Xyris and Demiurge are a toss-up atop this mid field. Sound keep.
Dominance with Eviscerate is the best Xyris pair; Iron Will with Cull the Weak was run.
augment: Sniper's Bounty: killing blows from Knock, Knock! grant 6 bonus gold, or 40 against heroes.
Sniper's Bounty is clearly the best augment in this mid field. Sound keep.
crest: Ortus's Limit Breaker grants 20% movement speed and 10% physical power for 7s; takedowns refresh the duration.
Liberator leans ahead in this mid field; Ortus ranks second among crests with enough games.
improvement: Lane record into Renna: 45.2%. Anti-heal via Tainted Blade and magical armor were NOT built.
Dominance with Eviscerate over Iron Will and Cull the Weak trades basic-attack and minion value for takedown heals and opening damage.

matchup: Offlane against Zarus, a 54% lane record; Zarus killed this offlaner twice and took the offlane inner.
Zarus's Barricade stuns; Zarus also took the mid inhibitor and the Core.
build: Overlord and Rapture are two of the 58.1% core; Aegis Of Agawar never made the build.
Tainted Guard adds 55 physical armor; basic attacks on the wearer cut the attacker's healing 45% for 3s.
eternal: Krix raises maximum health per level and adds size from maximum health.
Nihil leans ahead in this offlane field; Krix, the most played, ranks second.
Voracity with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair; Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism was run.
augment: Tainted Oath makes Sacred Oath apply 50% Blight to enemies for 4.5s.
Tainted Oath and Imperial Soul are a toss-up in this offlane field. Sound keep.
crest: Saphir's Mantle's Atlas grows size and max health 10% for 6s and deals true damage to nearby heroes.
Saphir's Mantle and Eviscerator are a toss-up atop this offlane field. Sound keep.
improvement: Lane record into Zarus: 54%. Tenacity via Salvation was NOT built; the anti-heal need was met.
Salvation over Rapture adds 25 tenacity and a low-health shield, giving up attack speed and on-hit damage.
Draft alternative: Kaelen offlane, at 55% in the field, fills the missing tank slot.

matchup: Jungle against Bayle, a 53.9% lane record; two kills on Bayle, yet Bayle took seven of eight enemy majors.
Bayle's Cursed Edge knocks up and stuns; Kingslayer knocks up.
build: None of the 63.8% core, Malady, Terminus and Necrosis, made the build.
Draconum's 40 physical armor met the armor need into Drongo's physical damage.
Sky Splitter deals 5% of the target's current health on basic attacks.
eternal: Knell shreds enemy armor with Rust stacks; Peal applies maximum Rust for 4s after the ultimate, on a 20s cooldown.
Lotus leans ahead in this jungle field; Knell ranks second.
Frequency with Resonant Repair is the best Knell pair; Frequency with Peal was run.
augment: Jungle Invasion grants physical power in the jungle, rising further in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion leans ahead in this jungle field, yet only 5 enemy-jungle minions fell against Bayle's 75.
crest: Judgement's Thunder Cleaver deals area damage and heals on hero hits, later hits at 50% effectiveness.
Pacifier and Gravitum are a toss-up atop this jungle field; Judgement ranks fourth among crests with enough games.
improvement: Lane record into Bayle: 53.9%. Tenacity via Salvation and anti-heal via Tainted Blade were NOT built; Draconum met armor.
Resonant Repair over Peal suits ten enemy hard-CC abilities: a heal and tenacity whenever immobilized, losing ultimate haste.
Tainted Blade cuts healing 45% on physical damage, into Bayle's 14453 healing, the most in the game.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Steel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 5/5 physical — predictable; the enemy itemizes one armor item against most of it. A magical pick would split their defenses.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Mercy for 3 Vengeance stacks, Dusk to purify for burst and slow, Shadow Glide to reposition, then Purge while gliding as needed.
ourKits.winCondition: Stack Vengeance with basics and abilities, then shred the team with Purge and reset Dusk and Shadow Glide on kills.
ourKits.passive: Nevermore periodically makes her next basic or Mercy fire a Raven that deals current-health damage in a small area.
ourKits.playWith: Peel that keeps divers off her while she channels Purge.
ourKits.playAgainst: During Purge she cannot attack or cast anything but Shadow Glide and is slowed, so CC her then. Avoid feeding takedowns since they reset Shadow Glide, and expect Purge's anti-heal.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link a carry, Psychic Flare around both of you to blind enemies facing it, Energy Lance to stack slows into a root, and Hyperflux to give both of you attack speed, ability haste and speed.
ourKits.winCondition: Power up a linked carry with the Link and Hyperflux and keep them healthy with Essence Catalyst healing.
ourKits.passive: Essence Catalyst: abilities heal her and her linked ally over time, and her Phase Blink has a shorter cooldown and boosts her damage.
ourKits.playWith: The strongest carry to Link, ideally one who wants attack speed and ability haste.
ourKits.playAgainst: Turn away from Psychic Flare, since it only blinds enemies facing it, and break Energy Lance's beam before it reaches the root. Anti-heal cuts the shared healing; focus the linked carry or force the Link out of range.

ourKits.combo: Peekaboo! to mark, reveal and slow → Knock, Knock! snipe on the marked target → Back It Up! to drag a fleeing hero back
ourKits.winCondition: land Knock, Knock! on Peekaboo!-marked targets for max-health damage and reset Surprise, Surprise! on takedowns
ourKits.passive: his vision item becomes a camouflaged Sonar Drone that reveals enemies through walls
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds targets still for his snipe, and teammates who follow up when Back It Up! returns a hero
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Peekaboo! since Knock, Knock! is much stronger on marked targets; after Back It Up! teleports you back, expect a follow-up, and pressure him after Surprise, Surprise! is spent

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
ourKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
ourKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
ourKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
enemyKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
enemyKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
enemyKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Mortal Coil to pull enemies together and heal from them, Stupor from the air to Mesmerize, Soulfire waves for damage, then Abyssal Rift to teleport in and fire the singularity.
enemyKits.winCondition: Collect Essence to grow every ability, then zone fights with Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift and execute low targets.
enemyKits.passive: Echoes of the Damned: nearby deaths can drop Essence (heroes always do) that she collects to empower her abilities, and she can hover after a mid-air jump.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline that keeps enemies inside Mortal Coil and the singularity.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch for the 1.5s Abyssal Rift channel and leave the target area, and dodge the Stupor orb after she rises. Anti-heal cuts Mortal Coil healing; trade early before she stacks Essence.

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slows on the way out and back, Gag Grenade silences, Rad Rounds stacks Irradiate on basics, then Shrapnel Cannon shreds armor and erupts Irradiate
enemyKits.winCondition: kite from range, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, and use Shrapnel Cannon to shred or escape
enemyKits.passive: critical strikes and ability hits apply a max-health bleed
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Gag Grenade's silence; Shrapnel Cannon cast in the air launches him away and is briefly unstoppable, so engage after it is used; armor blunts his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade to block then swing for a stun → Spear of Nyr (bonus damage on low targets) → Coliseum leap to finish
enemyKits.winCondition: leap onto a target with Coliseum for doubled Gladiator power and secure kills to stack permanent power
enemyKits.passive: Gladiator stacks grant physical power and heal him as they fall off after combat
enemyKits.playWith: a team that follows his Coliseum leap onto the target
enemyKits.playAgainst: Barricade only blocks from the front, so hit him from the side or behind and dodge its swing stun; disengage during Coliseum's doubled-power window, and buy armor and anti-heal

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher leaps in to shred armor and speed him toward the target, Cursed Edge's third slash knocks up and stuns, Dire Howl slows and buffs him, then Kingslayer uppercuts and pummels a hero
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, sustain through Dire Howl omnivamp, and out-brawl with Berserk when low
enemyKits.passive: below 35% Max Health he goes Berserk with attack speed, movement speed and tenacity, once every 20s
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the horizontal third slash of Cursed Edge and sidestep the Kingslayer dash during its slowed charge-up; burst him through Berserk or disengage until it ends; anti-heal cuts Dire Howl healing and armor helps against his physical damage

checks.text: No real tank: nobody to start fights or take the first hits for the backline.
Out-tanked 0 v 1: teams one tank down won 47.9% in 1.18.
2 divers (Greystone, Khaimera): each one past the first is a hero not holding the line.
5 of 5 deal physical damage: one armor item blunts most of it.
One main mage and one main marksman at most.
Phase can stay with the carry and peel.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,315 hero damage a minute, more than 85% of Drongo carry players this patch (42% of the team's). The damage came from Tainted Rounds, Imperator, Xyris.
Drongo dealt 32,871 hero damage, 42% of their team's, with +222 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Khaimera (level 13: about 114 physical armor, 102 after penetration; took 15,467 physical damage from heroes, 69% of all hero damage they took) and Kira (level 13: about 86 physical armor, 74 after penetration; took 7,688 physical damage from heroes, 64% of all hero damage they took) that is about 6% and 7% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Xyris (Eternal): Deal 3% bonus damage, increased by 0.4% per 10 units killed, up to 400 units.
Bring The Boom (augment): Rad Rounds deals 60% of its damage to nearby Enemies upon exploding.

Sustain: 22% lifesteal; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; Liberator: Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.; 1,376 healing recorded.

Loadout augment Bring The Boom: When Rad Rounds' stacks erupt on a target, part of that damage also hits enemies around them. Shoot the frontline during Rad Rounds to splash the group behind it. (game text: Rad Rounds deals 60% of its damage to nearby Enemies upon exploding.) (changes Rad Rounds, 12s cooldown with their haste) Field: 49.6% in 14966 games, 70% of picks, level the hero-role's 49.9%.

Loadout Eternal Xyris: Bonus damage that grows as you kill units through the game. Plain scaling for a farming carry, nothing tied to the kit. (game text: Deal 3% bonus damage, increased by 0.4% per 10 units killed, up to 400 units.) Field: 51.7% in 3023 games, 14% of picks, above the hero-role's 49.9%.

Loadout minor Furor: A burst of attack speed when you enter hero combat. Stacks with Rad Rounds for a fast opening flurry. (game text: Entering Hero Combat grants 20% Total Attack Speed for 4s.) Field: 52.1% in 1587 games, 52% of picks, above the hero-role's 49.9%.

Loadout minor Bone Collector: After killing 150 units, Drongo permanently gains 20% critical chance. Critical strikes also apply the Wastelander bleed, so the bonus adds bleed damage as well as harder hits. (game text: After killing 150 units, permanently gain 20% Critical Chance.) Field: 51.5% in 2252 games, 74% of picks, above the hero-role's 49.9%.

Loadout crest Liberator: Removes crowd control and gives a short shield. Use it when you get stunned or slowed by a diver so you can keep shooting. (game text: Purifying Guard:  Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.) Field: 50.8% in 3798 games, 18% of picks, level the hero-role's 49.9%.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Terminus, Liberator.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Terminus, Liberator. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Drongo killed built physical armor (Khaimera, Greystone). Anti-heal on Kira, Greystone. We killed Drongo 2 times.
Copy it? Xyris (Furor + Bone Collector): 51% in 1,064 Drongo carry games, above the hero's 49.9%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

gameFlags.summary: draft broke the fundamentals: 0 tanks, 2 divers vs 1 tank, 2 divers
evidence: Us 0 tanks, 2 divers (48% in 1.18 ranked) vs them 1 tank, 2 divers (49.8%).
No real tank: nobody to start fights or take the first hits for the backline.
Out-tanked 0 v 1: teams one tank down won 47.9% in 1.18.
2 divers (Greystone, Khaimera): each one past the first is a hero not holding the line.
5 of 5 deal physical damage: one armor item blunts most of it.
Draft fix: Greystone (offlane) for a real tank: Kaelen 55%, Riktor 51.1%, Steel 50.6%.
Drongo 14/2/1, 61% of their kills, 32871 hero damage (the most in the game).
Killed Khaimera 5, Phase 3, Kira 3, Wraith 2, Greystone 1.
Hard CC: Gag Grenade (silence), Shrapnel Cannon (knockback).
Mobility: Shrapnel Cannon.
Unstoppable on Shrapnel Cannon: CC does not stop it.
Play against: dodge Gag Grenade's silence; Shrapnel Cannon cast in the air launches him away and is briefly unstoppable, so engage after it is used; armor blunts his physical damage
Answers: Physical armor on whoever it kept killing. Tenacity on the players it caught.

They brought 10 hard-CC abilities to our 3. Fight after Steel's Shield Slam and Renna's Stupor and Drongo's Gag Grenade are used, spread out instead of grouping in a line, and the front line can buy tenacity.
Theirs: Steel Shield Bash, Steel Bull Rush, Steel Shield Slam, Renna Mortal Coil, Renna Stupor, Drongo Gag Grenade, Drongo Shrapnel Cannon, Zarus Barricade, Bayle Cursed Edge, Bayle Kingslayer.

bullets: Xyris added bonus damage that grew with units killed, and Furor gave extra attack speed on entering hero combat, stacking with Rad Rounds for more Lucy shots.
More Lucy shots meant more Tainted Rounds hits: each basic attack cut the target's healing and dealt bonus on-hit damage that grew as the target's health dropped.
Bone Collector's permanent critical chance, unlocked after enough unit kills, fed Imperator's harder critical strikes, and every critical strike also applied the Wastelander bleed to the target.
Krix raised Steel's maximum health, Cannibalism added more with every takedown, and more health grew the Cybernetic Shell, which shields Steel for a share of maximum health.
Regenerative Tissue slowly heals Steel after a while without taking hero damage; Cybernetic Shell returns only after taking no damage at all, so backing fully out restores both.
Casting Bull Rush or Shield Slam fired an Inquisition wave, which waits a brief cooldown between waves, while Fire Blossom kept burning nearby enemies after Steel dove in.

coachLean.headline: Five lost fights each became an enemy prize, towers went 1-9 against the squad, and the lone won fight took nothing.

flags.text: Enemy took three Fangtooths, Mini Prime, Shaper, Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth; the squad took two Seedlings.
Drongo went 14/2/1 with 32871 hero damage, 42% of the enemy team's, plus 30850 objective damage.
Enemy brought 10 hard-CC abilities to 3: stuns from Steel, Zarus and Bayle, a sleep from Renna.
Draft ran no tank, two divers in Greystone and Khaimera, and 5 of 5 physical damage dealers.

focus.action: Fight only after Steel's Shield Slam, Renna's Stupor and Drongo's Gag Grenade are spent, spread out, then open with Khaimera's Cull into Wraith's Knock, Knock! while Phase roots divers off Kira.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Farm held at 8 CS a minute against an own average of 7.6, but hero damage sat at 555 a minute against an own average of 1021.
Drongo took 3 of 4 deaths; the play is to sidestep Gag Grenade's silence and duel only after Shrapnel Cannon is spent.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Healing reached 7459 with 30% kill participation, but wards stopped at 9 against an own average of 10.7, with 0 cleared.
Every death went to Drongo, 3 of 3: hold the Energy Lance root for the diver on Kira and sidestep Gag Grenade.
Practice target: clear enemy wards before each Fangtooth setup; the enemy destroyed 5 wards to the squad's 3.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Ran the vision: 20 wards placed and 3 cleared, the only clears on the squad, plus both Seedlings the squad took.
Hero damage dropped to 340 a minute against an own average of 679, across 6 deaths, three outside detected fights.
Practice target: wait out Renna's Stupor and Steel's Shield Slam, then follow Khaimera's Cull with Knock, Knock! for the kill.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Top farm on the squad: 9.6 CS a minute against an own average of 7.7, with 28413 damage mitigated.
Left the unopened offlane to kill Renna on mid, then died to Drongo there, and the offlane inner tower fell on the same trip.
Front-line target: hold the dive until Steel's Shield Slam and Bayle's Cursed Edge are spent, since the draft had no tank.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Drove the early tempo: first blood on Steel, 6 kills, 70% kill participation and all 896 of the squad's objective damage.
Seven deaths, 5 to Drongo and the most on the squad; the last two came outside detected fights before Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth.
Into Drongo: dodge Gag Grenade's silence and commit Cull only after Shrapnel Cannon launches Drongo away.
